# Game typefaces

The project owner confirms redistribution rights for game typefaces used in
Waypoint. These files are source copies of the binaries compiled from
`app/src/main/res/font/`; keep both folders in sync when updating a face.

| File | Face | Public source page |
|---|---|---|
| `kirsty_regular.ttf` | Kirsty Rg Regular 4.001 | [FontGet Kirsty family](https://www.fontget.com/font/kirsty-family/) |
| `kirsty_bold.ttf` | Kirsty Rg Bold 4.001 | [FontGet Kirsty family](https://www.fontget.com/font/kirsty-family/) |
| `chinese_rocks_regular.otf` | Chinese Rocks Rg Regular | [1001 Fonts Chinese Rocks](https://www.1001fonts.com/chinese-rocks-free-font.html) |
| `pricedown_black.otf` | Pricedown Black | [1001 Fonts Pricedown](https://www.1001fonts.com/pricedown-font.html) |

The owner explicitly reaffirmed their game-font licenses and asked for online
sourcing in this task. Public download pages are provenance records, not the basis
for app embedding or source redistribution. The separately confirmed owner rights
apply; the binaries retain their original copyright and license metadata.

Additional sourced families for 1.6.0:

| Files | Family | Origin |
|---|---|---|
| `borda_regular.ttf`, `borda_bold.ttf` | Borda | Official Ubisoft Division 2 WOFF resources, decoded without altering outlines. |
| `stratum2_regular.ttf`, `stratum2_bold.ttf` | Stratum 2 | Official Counter-Strike WOFF resources; upstream obfuscated internal names retained. |
| `minecraft_seven.ttf` | Minecraft Seven | Mojang content-addressed resource. |
| `windlass.ttf` | Windlass base Regular 1.0 | Public archive of the Scriptorium font. This is not Rare's extended game build. |
| `futura_condensed_medium.ttf` | Futura Condensed Medium | Owner's installed Futura collection, selected by PostScript name. |

Exact source URLs, final binary hashes, family/version metadata, preserved
copyright and license notices, and conversion details are recorded in
[sourced-fonts.json](sourced-fonts.json). The installed Futura file was sourced
locally after online family research; it was not downloaded from the foundry.
